@'
import os,sys,unittest,logging
from unittest.mock import patch
os.environ['DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE']='config.settings_sqlite_test'
sys.path.insert(0,'backend')
from django.db.backends.base.base import BaseDatabaseWrapper
with patch.object(BaseDatabaseWrapper,'ensure_connection',side_effect=AssertionError('Database connections forbidden')):
 import django
 django.setup()
 logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
 from django.conf import settings
 assert all(c['ENGINE']=='django.db.backends.sqlite3' for c in settings.DATABASES.values())
 suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(['learner_api.test_dashboard_overview_no_db','learner_api.test_dashboard_tabs_no_db','learner_api.test_dashboard_header_no_db','learner_api.test_dashboard_weekly_no_db','learner_api.test_dashboard_monthly_no_db','learner_api.test_dashboard_training_no_db'])
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(suite)
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
'@ | .\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -
